purpose: Theme-first outfit purchase and home/gameplay preview flow
scope: Preview artwork; production screens, prices, saves and build are unchanged.
review: Four theme options only: 暖红, 竹影, 海风, 秋夜.
Whole theme browsing is primary; 自由搭配 is a secondary link.
Preview selection is distinct from actual equipped state.
Confirmation displays owned-item deduction and exact post-purchase balance.
No component catalogue or mandatory individual purchase steps on theme page.
Bamboo gameplay preview coordinates roof, lamps, stool and bottom tablecloth.
Tablecloth belongs to the furnishing set rather than an extra paid slot.
The displayed gameplay is a visual concept, not evidence of production integration.
This sheet covers the partial-ownership affordable purchase path; insufficient funds, locked themes and save errors remain implementation states.
